title: DMR: a repeater with both timeslots busy, then two radios in direct mode
description: DMR Tier II on 439.0125 MHz, colour code 1 (voice LC header, voice superframes with EMB + embedded LC, terminator; placeholder AMBE+2 frames with valid FEC). A repeater (300 deg, CACH, idle bursts on a free slot) carries 3100001 -> TG 1 on slot 1 and, overlapping it, 3100002 -> TG 2 on slot 2 - both radios' bearing is the repeater's. Then radio 3100011 (60 deg) on direct-mode timeslot 1 and radio 3100012 (200 deg) on timeslot 2. Expect talkers 3100001 + 3100002 at 300 deg, 3100011 at 60 deg, 3100012 at 200 deg.

title: DMR Tier III trunking: a control channel and three calls on two payload channels
description: Made-up DMR Tier III system Small network 37 site 5. The TSCC on 439.5125 MHz (timeslot 1, colour code 1, bearing 300 deg) sends C_ALOHA, call timers, an adjacent site (6 on channel 320) and a Chan_Freq announcement of channel 301 = 438.7125 MHz (uplink 433.7125). Grants: TG 1201 from 3100001 on channel 301 slot 1 at 1.0 s; TG 1305 from 3100003 on channel 301 slot 2 at 5.3 s (the call is encrypted: privacy indication); TG 1400 from 3100002 on channel 302 slot 1 at 7.5 s with appended absolute parameters (439.1125 MHz, uplink 434.1125, colour code 2); each repeated once a second as a late-entry grant. The calls start 0.35 s after their grants, end with a terminator and are cleared with P_CLEAR 0.6 s (TG 1201) / 1 s later. On channel 301 each timeslot comes from its own transmitter (slot 1 at 40 deg, slot 2 at 160 deg: the per-slot path, one call after the other), channel 302 at 220 deg. Expect (system) / (grant) on VFO 0 and with trunk following a voice VFO per call: talkers 3100001 at 40, 3100003 at 160, 3100002 at 220 deg.
